title: pQCee Enters U.S. Public Sector Through Carahsoft Master Aggregator Agreement - Quantum Computing Report
author: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
text:
pQCee Pte Ltd has partnered with government IT distributor Carahsoft Technology Corp. to supply its post-quantum cybersecurity software across U.S. public-sector markets. Serving as Master Government Aggregator, Carahsoft will distribute pQCee’s encryption suites to federal, municipal, educational, and healthcare buyers through its reseller ecosystem and existing cooperative purchasing contracts.

The distribution channel addresses immediate compliance pressures from Executive Order 14412, which establishes binding federal milestones to transition high-value systems away from vulnerable public-key cryptography. Because complete architectural replacements are budget-prohibitive across legacy environments, public entities are prioritizing drop-in encryption layers that enforce NIST-standardized post-quantum algorithms without interrupting active digital operations.
